title: SynthesizeFinalAnswerRequested
description: Command emitted by the aggregator to trigger final answer synthesis. Topic: user-commands. Producer: aggregator.ts. Consumer: answerSynthesizer.ts.

conversationId.description: Unique identifier for the conversation (partition key)

sessionId.description: WebSocket session identifier for routing the answer back to the browser

commandType.description: Uses commandType (not eventType) to distinguish CQRS commands from events

results.description: All tool results to be synthesized into the final answer
